import sys, os, wave, tempfile
import winsound
from pathlib import Path
from piper import PiperVoice
from piper.config import SynthesisConfig
name, vdir, ls = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], float(sys.argv[3])
model = Path(vdir) / (name + ".onnx")
conf = Path(vdir) / (name + ".onnx.json")
def complete():
    return model.exists() and conf.exists() and model.stat().st_size > 1000000 and conf.stat().st_size > 100
if not complete():
    print("DOWNLOADING", flush=True)
    for f in (model, conf):
        try:
            f.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass
    try:
        from piper.download_voices import download_voice
        download_voice(name, Path(vdir), force_redownload=True)
    except Exception as e:
        for f in (model, conf):
            try:
                f.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
        sys.stderr.write("VOICE_DOWNLOAD_BLOCKED %s\n" % e)
        sys.exit(1)
    if not complete():
        sys.stderr.write("VOICE_DOWNLOAD_BLOCKED incomplete download\n")
        sys.exit(1)
voice = PiperVoice.load(str(model))
cfg = SynthesisConfig(length_scale=ls)
print("READY", flush=True)
tmp = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "zenko_voice_%d.wav")
n = 0
for line in sys.stdin:
    t = line.strip()
    if t == "__STOP__":
        winsound.PlaySound(None, 0)
        continue
    if not t:
        continue
    n = (n + 1) % 2
    with wave.open(tmp % n, "wb") as w:
        voice.synthesize_wav(t, w, syn_config=cfg)
    winsound.PlaySound(tmp % n, winsound.SND_FILENAME | winsound.SND_ASYNC)
WHISPER_WORKER:
import sys, json, time
import numpy as np
import sounddevice as sd
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
model_name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "small.en"
prompt = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
model = WhisperModel(model_name, device="cpu", compute_type="int8")
print(json.dumps({"ready": True, "model": model_name}), flush=True)
chunks, rec, stream = [], False, None
def cb(indata, frames, t, status):
    if rec:
        chunks.append(indata.copy())
def close():
    global stream
    try:
        stream.stop(); stream.close()
    except Exception:
        pass
    stream = None
for line in sys.stdin:
    cmd = line.strip()
    if cmd == "start" and not rec:
        chunks.clear(); rec = True
        stream = sd.InputStream(samplerate=16000, channels=1, dtype="float32", callback=cb, blocksize=800); stream.start()
        print(json.dumps({"listening": True}), flush=True)
    elif cmd == "cancel" and rec:
        rec = False; close(); chunks.clear()
        print(json.dumps({"cancelled": True}), flush=True)
    elif cmd == "stop" and rec:
        time.sleep(0.35)                      # catch the end of the last word
        rec = False; close()
        if not chunks:
            print(json.dumps({"text": ""}), flush=True); continue
        audio = np.concatenate(chunks)[:, 0]
        if len(audio) < 16000 * 0.5:
            print(json.dumps({"text": ""}), flush=True); continue
        peak = float(np.max(np.abs(audio)))
        if 0.003 < peak < 0.5:
            audio = audio * (0.5 / peak)      # quiet microphones: boost the level
        segs, info = model.transcribe(audio, language="en", beam_size=5, vad_filter=True,
                                      vad_parameters={"min_silence_duration_ms": 600},
                                      initial_prompt=prompt, condition_on_previous_text=False)
        print(json.dumps({"text": " ".join(s.text.strip() for s in segs).strip()}), flush=True)
    elif cmd == "quit":
        break
